name: Find a Label
description: Finds a label on a specific board by name. [See the documentation](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/trello/rest/api-group-boards/#api-boards-id-labels-get)

configurable_props.name: board
configurable_props.label: Board
configurable_props.description: Unique identifier of the board to search for labels

configurable_props.name: name
configurable_props.label: Label Name
configurable_props.description: Name of the label to find.

configurable_props.name: limit
configurable_props.label: Limit
configurable_props.description: The number of labels to be returned (up to 1000)
